name: Home mail reader
line: A private tool that reads its owner's own Gmail, read-only.
description: Home mail reader, a private tool that reads its owner's own Gmail, read-only.
about: Home mail reader is a small tool that its owner runs at home to keep up with the owner's own email. It reads mail with Google's read-only Gmail access, so it can't send, change or delete anything.
It's for one person's own use. It isn't offered to anyone else, and no one else signs in to it.

privacy.intro: This policy covers Home mail reader, a private tool that reads its owner's own Gmail. Only its owner signs in to it, with the owner's own Google accounts.
collects: With the read-only Gmail access that the owner grants at Google's sign-in, it reads the messages in the owner's own Gmail accounts, with their headers and labels.
It can't send, change or delete mail, and it reads nothing else in the Google account.
privacy.uses: Only to help the owner keep up with the owner's own mail, for example by showing it, sorting it and noting what needs an answer.
privacy.shares: It's never sold, used for ads or used to train AI models. What it reads is kept on the owner's own devices. The owner may let an AI assistant read some of it, only to help with the owner's own mail.
privacy.keeps: For as long as the owner keeps it on those devices. Removing the tool's access in the Google account stops all further reading.
privacy.choices: The owner can remove its access at any time, under [Third-party apps and services](https://myaccount.google.com/connections) in the Google account.

extra.heading: Google user data
paragraphs: Home mail reader's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the [Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.
Home mail reader is a private tool for its owner's own use. It isn't offered, sold or licensed to anyone else, and no one else may sign in to it.

sections.heading: As is
paragraphs: It's provided as is, with no promise that it works or stays available.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: These terms may change. The date above shows the latest version.
